citations.assessment: The digital Bavli gives Rav Yehudah bar Kaza reciting in the baraita of the house of Bar Kaza. Heilprin’s wording retains the two occurrences but lacks the explicit school marker.
Rashi explicitly glosses Bar Kaza as a sage’s name. The gloss in itself leaves the relationship between the two mentions open.
